Senior Platform Engineer
Velvetquarry Systems, remote

About the role
Velvetquarry Systems builds scheduling software for small warehouses.
We are looking for a platform engineer to own our deployment pipeline
and the services that run customer jobs.

What you will do
- Own the deployment pipeline and its reliability.
- Design and run the job scheduler that customers rely on.
- Improve build times and the release process.
- Write runbooks and take part in the on-call rotation.
- Mentor engineers on the team.

What we look for
- Seven or more years of experience in platform or infrastructure work.
- Strong skills in Python or Go.
- Experience with containers and an orchestration system.
- A habit of writing tests and documentation.
- Clear written communication.

Nice to have
- Experience with batch processing.
- Experience leading a small team.
